Reproducibility

Verification and provenance

The library and its independent statement compile with Lean 4.35.0-rc3. Their axiom reports contain only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The six deliberate Challenge placeholders are not part of the proof.

November 8, 2026 (commit e6e95f6, Lean v4.35.0-rc3, module system): build passed (2477 jobs including Challenge and Solution); axiom audit of 23 declarations passed with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, and a scan of all 1811 declarations found no other axiom. lake comparator check of the independent statements of Theorem A, Theorem 3.6, Theorems 7.5 and 8.5 and Theorem B passed with con-ron, NanoDa and Lean kernel replay. The hosted Palomar preflight (run 42473438479, PalomarSubmission 14aa8d6, palomar-standard-v1) passed on commit 4690a5e, whose Lean sources are those of e6e95f6, with NanoDa and con-ron (23534 declarations) accepting. On November 11, 2026, commit da7ea8e cites the posted paper hexagon:2611.00207v1 (TeX source identical to the formalized version); its hosted preflight (run 42842279381) passed.

Build the project

lake exe cache get
lake build
python3 scripts/audit_axioms.py
python3 scripts/scan_axioms.py
python3 scripts/generate_challenge.py --check
lake build Challenge Solution

With Mathlib's cache in place, the library builds in about one minute on 20 hardware threads. Build Challenge Solution before independent comparison with scripts/verify-comparator.sh.

What has been reviewed

No human expert or independent audit has reviewed the Lean statements or the proofs. Lean checks the proofs; the match between Challenge.lean and the paper is a human judgement.
